Most of the old navigation moved closer to the content. Boards sit in a single quick menu, featured sections became modules in the curated zone, and category tags became hashtags members can tap from any post.

One feed on app and web

The app and web share the same structure: a fixed top with quick access to boards, followed by the curated zone and the feed. On web, the feed sits in a centred column, with the main navigation on the left and a profile panel on the right.
